items.q: How often should I see a dentist if my teeth feel fine?
items.a: Even if your teeth feel fine, it's important to see a dentist regularly. Some dental issues, like cavities or gum disease, may not show symptoms until they are more advanced. Regular check-ups can help catch these issues early, ensuring a healthy smile for life.

items.q: What can I expect during a dental cleaning at Younes Dental Clinic?
items.a: During your dental cleaning, our hygienist will thoroughly clean your teeth, removing plaque and tartar buildup. We will also check your gums for any signs of disease and polish your teeth, leaving you with a fresh, clean smile.

items.q: How do I know if I need dental implants?
items.a: Dental implants are an excellent solution if you're missing one or more teeth. They provide a permanent, natural-looking replacement that functions like your natural teeth. If you're considering implants, our experienced surgeons can assess your situation and recommend the best treatment plan.

items.q: What are the benefits of using the latest dental technology?
items.a: Utilizing the latest dental technology, such as 3D imaging and CAD/CAM systems, allows us to provide more accurate diagnoses, create precise treatment plans, and deliver superior results. This means less time in the chair and more effective treatments for you.

items.q: How long do dental implants last?
items.a: Dental implants are designed to be a permanent solution for tooth loss. With proper care, including regular dental visits and good oral hygiene, your implants can last a lifetime.

items.q: What should I do if I suspect I have gum disease?
items.a: If you notice symptoms like red, swollen, or bleeding gums, it's important to see a dentist as soon as possible. Gum disease is most treatable in its early stages, and our periodontal care can help prevent it from progressing.
